name: kalshi-crypto-fees
notes: Structural gates over one `fee_schedules` pull of source kalshi-crypto: one row per series, as the venue reports it today. The fee model decides whether a maker quote has edge, so a change of fee TYPE must be seen. Run: python -m dskit.onboarding validate --suite configs/suite-kalshi-crypto-fees.json --snapshot <snapshot-vid> --root <store root>.

rules.notes: One schedule per series. Six restates the series list; the pin test keeps them equal.
The six series the source pulls, RESTATED here on purpose: a suite must not read its vocabulary from the source it validates. tests/test_configs.py pins the two lists together.
All six read quadratic on 2026-10-06. Another type (for example the variant that charges makers) changes the quoting economics: warn so the fee model is re-read, not blocked.

The stage B fee model prices rate = 0.07 x fee_multiplier, and 0.07 is Kalshi's standard taker coefficient; all six series read multiplier 1 on 2026-10-06. Another value is read and priced, but warn so a changed schedule is seen, never silently absorbed.
